title: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2602.12706v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural operators have emerged as fast surrogate solvers for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs). However, purely data-driven models often require extensive training data and can generalize poorly, especially in small-data regimes and under unseen (out-of-distribution) input functions that are not represented in the training data. To address these limitations, we propose the Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator (PILNO), which enhances the Laplace Neural Operator (LNO) by embedding governing physics into training through PDE, boundary condition, and initial condition residuals. To improve expressivity, we first introduce an Advanced LNO (ALNO) backbone that retains a pole-residue transient representation while replacing the steady-state branch with an FNO-style Fourier multiplier. To make physics-informed training both data-efficient and robust, PILNO further leverages (i) virtual inputs: an unlabeled ensemble of input

translated_title: 物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子用于求解偏微分方程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.12706v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：神经算子已成为参数化偏微分方程（PDEs）的快速替代求解器。然而，纯数据驱动模型通常需要大量训练数据，并且泛化能力较差，尤其是在小数据场景和训练数据中未出现的未见（分布外）输入函数情况下。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子（PILNO），它通过将PDE、边界条件和初始条件残差嵌入训练中，从而增强拉普拉斯神经算子（LNO），使物理规律融入学习过程。为提高表达能力，我们首先引入了一种高级LNO（ALNO）骨干结构，该结构保留了极点-残差瞬态表示，同时将稳态分支替换为FNO风格的傅里叶乘子。为使物理信息训练既高效又稳健，PILNO进一步利用了（i）虚拟输入：一组未标记的输入集成。
tldr: 本文提出了物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子（PILNO），通过嵌入物理残差和虚拟输入机制，显著提升了拉普拉斯神经算子在数据稀缺和分布外场景下的泛化能力与训练效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator (PILNO), which embeds physics residuals and virtual inputs to significantly improve the generalization and training efficiency of Laplace neural operators in data-scarce and out-of-distribution scenarios.
